title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay San Sebastian, Municipality of Tabina, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to be Known as Tabina National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay San Sebastian, Municipality of Tabina, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to be Known as Tabina National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Sebastian, เทศบาล Tabina, จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Tabina

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay San Sebastian, Municipality of Tabina, Province of Zamboanga del Sur to be known as Tabina National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tabina National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
